whatIsIt.simple: A placeholder layer that does nothing. YOLOv9-E's config starts with one so that layer 0 can be referenced by later layers.

whyExists.eli5: It gives the input a number other layers can point to.
whyExists.simple: Later CBLinear/CBFuse rows need to reference the input image as a layer index.
whyExists.engineer: Index anchor for the dual-backbone graph.
